proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ _ f
  classical
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · exact ⟨0, 1, Polynomial.isPrimitive_one, by simp [hf]⟩
  · have key : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, ∃ d : A, (∀ i ∈ s, d ∣ f.coeff i) ∧ ∀ e : A, (∀ i ∈ s, e ∣ f.coeff i) → e ∣ d := by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => exact ⟨0, by simp, fun e _ => dvd_zero e⟩
      | insert i s _ ih =>
        obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := ih
        refine ⟨gcd (f.coeff i) d, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro j hj
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
          · exact gcd_dvd_left _ _
          · exact (gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (hd j hj)
        · intro e he
          exact dvd_gcd (he i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)) (hd' e fun j hj => he j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := key f.support
    have hall : ∀ n, c ∣ f.coeff n := by
      intro n
      by_cases hn : n ∈ f.support
      · exact hc n hn
      · rw [Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hn]
        exact dvd_zero c
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff c f).mpr hall
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      apply hf
      simpa using hg
    refine ⟨c, g, ?_, hg⟩
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hr
    have hdvd : c * r ∣ c := by
      refine hc' (c * r) fun i _ => ?_
      have hfc : f = Polynomial.C (c * r) * h := by
        rw [hg, hh, Polynomial.C_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [hfc, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
      exact dvd_mul_right _ _
    have hone : c * r ∣ c * 1 := by simpa using hdvd
    exact isUnit_of_dvd_one ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hc0).mp hone)
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [GCDMonoid A] (f : Polynomial A), ∃ (c : A) (g : Polynomial A), g.IsPrimitive ∧ f = Polynomial.C c * g
